title: Clue: finding the right Knight
screen:
How to find the right Knight.

Look at the orange Enemy's Face on the Scout Cell. It sits in the Display Window (MHC). It has four bumps. From left to right: medium, tall, short, medium.

Every Knight hangs a blue lock below it (its TCR). Each lock has four notches. Only one lock has notches of exactly those depths, in the same order: medium, tall, short, medium. That lock fits the face perfectly.

To test a Knight: tap it. Or move the yellow ring with the left and right keys (or A and D) and press E. A wrong Knight just gets crossed out and greyed. You cannot lose, so keep testing until one fits.

Still stuck? Close this clue, and the matching Knight glows green for a few seconds.
wait: The chosen Knight is docking on the Scout Cell. Now come the Three Handshakes. 1: the lock fits the Enemy's Face. 2: a second 'this is real' touch (CD28). 3: a 'go!' message (IL-12). After all three, the Knight wakes up and copies itself into an army.
